newsitem.title: UK: SocGen appoints convertibles research head.
newsitem.headline: SocGen appoints convertibles research head.

text.p: Societe Generale said in a statement on Thursday it had appointed Jim Grantham as head of global convertibles research products.
"Societe Generale has built up an impressive global network, and it is a key player in the buoyant French convertibles market, particularly in new issues," Grantham said in the statement.
Grantham, who has over 25 years specialising in convertibles and warrants, joins SocGen from BZW.
He has also in the past been voted number one or two in investor surveys on convertibles. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7718
